content.user_title: Create Brand Guidelines and Consistency Checks
content.value_statement: Brand teams need consistent rules for visual identity, voice, and channel execution. This skill provides templates, audits, and practical guidance for building and applying brand standards.
actual_capabilities: Drafts brand guideline structures covering logo, color, typography, imagery, layout, and voice.
Reviews materials against brand standards using audit categories and severity levels.
Creates logo usage rules, clear-space guidance, minimum sizes, and misuse examples.
Defines brand voice traits, tone by channel, messaging frameworks, and writing rules.
Guides multi-brand, sub-brand, co-branding, and brand governance workflows.
Includes example templates and reference documents for guideline creation.
limitations: Does not generate final visual assets or replace professional design review.
Requires accurate brand inputs, assets, and stakeholder decisions from the user.
Does not verify trademark, licensing, or legal clearance for brand elements.
Cannot enforce brand compliance inside external design or publishing systems.

use_cases.title: Build a Brand Style Guide
use_cases.description: Create a structured guide for logo usage, colors, typography, imagery, voice, and applications.

use_cases.title: Audit Marketing Materials
use_cases.description: Review campaigns, presentations, websites, and social posts for brand consistency and accessibility issues.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Multi-Brand Systems
use_cases.description: Define shared rules, exceptions, approval paths, and co-branding standards for related brands.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Brand Guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a first brand guideline outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a brand guideline outline for a new organization. Include logo, color, typography, imagery, voice, and application sections.

prompt_templates.title: Define Visual Standards
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for specific visual identity rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my brand inputs to draft logo usage, color palette, typography hierarchy, spacing, imagery, and accessibility rules.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Brand Compliance
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for reviewing existing materials.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this material against brand standards. Identify issues by category, assign severity, and recommend concrete corrections.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Brand Governance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for complex brand architecture.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a governance plan for parent, sub-brand, and partner-brand usage. Include shared rules, exceptions, approvals, and training needs.

output_examples.input: Create logo usage rules for a software brand.
output: Defines primary, secondary, icon, monochrome, and reversed logo versions.
Specifies clear space, minimum size, background rules, and prohibited alterations.
Adds practical examples for correct and incorrect usage.

output_examples.input: Audit a campaign landing page for brand consistency.
output: Flags color, typography, imagery, layout, accessibility, and voice issues.
Groups issues by severity so urgent fixes are clear.
Recommends specific updates that preserve the campaign goal.

output_examples.input: Create voice rules for support and marketing content.
output: Defines shared voice traits and channel-specific tone shifts.
Provides preferred wording, terms to avoid, and message structure guidance.
Explains how to keep technical content clear and approachable.

best_practices: Start with brand strategy and audience needs before defining visual or voice rules.
Document exact values, examples, approval rules, and accessibility requirements.
Review guidelines regularly and update them when products, channels, or audiences change.
anti_patterns: Do not create vague rules that leave teams guessing about acceptable usage.
Do not approve colors, fonts, or templates without checking accessibility and licensing.
Do not treat brand guidelines as static documents that never receive maintenance.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create brand guidelines, logo rules, color systems, typography standards, voice guidance, and application workflows.

faq.question: Can it audit existing materials?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review materials for brand consistency, accessibility, tone, layout, and usage issues.

faq.question: Does it create finished logos or images?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, rules, templates, and review criteria for brand assets.

faq.question: Can it support multiple brands?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for sub-brands, brand families, co-branding, approvals, and exceptions.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide existing assets, color values, typefaces, voice samples, audience details, and business goals.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is documentation-based and can guide brand work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
